native_multi_node_task_graph.safe_retry_boundary: The contract path is wired, and a response lost after schedule_retry commit is exactly replayed only when Attempt, Node, Lease, Graph, Budget, BudgetUsage, and related Outboxes still match; retry budget is not charged twice. Current Host, Scheduler, and Internal production resolvers do not emit RetryableWorkerPreparationError. Exceptions after operation reservation are never auto-retried, and CancelledError is not converted into an ordinary worker failure.
native_multi_node_task_graph.terminal_failure_boundary: Ordinary and exhausted pre-reservation resolver failures atomically close Attempt, Node, Graph, Lease and four attempt/evidence-bound Outboxes. Any existing operation reservation rejects this path, and Budget finalization remains outside the bundle.
native_multi_node_task_graph.heartbeat_boundary: After operation reservation, DurableExecutionHeartbeat renews Lease before Reservation, checkpoints worker stream events and the final result, and joins before COMMIT. Renewal response loss is exactly replayed. Any heartbeat failure yields RECOVERY_REQUIRED and forbids COMMIT, but does not provide online takeover, immediate reconciliation, or continuation.
native_multi_node_task_graph.startup_recovery_boundary: Startup is ordered migration -> task_store.recover_startup -> publisher construction -> recovery outbox publication -> later runtime activation. Recovery exceptions fail closed before route activation. ASGI derives a construction-scoped execution owner from the configured logical owner. This does not provide online takeover, reconciliation completion, or automatic continuation.
